conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Criminal Investigations Division. This is Officer Taylor. Who am I speaking with?
My name is Prashant Mehta. I got a call saying there was a problem with my taxes? I wanted to make sure I understand what is happening.
Mr. Mehta, I have your file here. Our records show discrepancies in your federal tax filings for the last two years. This relates to unpaid taxes and suspected tax evasion.
Sorry, I am not familiar with these processes. I always submit my returns through my employer. What is the issue exactly?
The issue, sir, is that there is a significant underreporting of your income. According to the IRS, you owe over $5,000, and a federal warrant for your arrest has already been generated this morning.
A warrant? Arrest? I do not understand. I am working here on a visa. What should I do? Can you please explain?

Let me be very clear, Mr. Mehta. If you do not settle this right now, you will be taken into custody, your work authorization will be suspended, and your bank accounts may be frozen. Do you understand the seriousness?
No, I cannot be arrested. This is my livelihood, and I cannot lose my visa. How can I resolve this?

You must make an immediate payment to stop the arrest warrant. If you cooperate now, we can initiate a 'temporary hold' on your case. Do you have access to your bank account or credit card at this moment?
I have my bank account, but I am not sure what to do. How do I pay the IRS directly?
Due to the urgency, the IRS only accepts electronic payments today. You can use Zelle or a wire transfer to our secure government account. Do you have your online banking ready?
Yes, I can use online banking. What information do I need?
Write this down: Routing number 021000021, Account number 9345761128. The account is registered as 'US Treasury Collections.' You must send $5,000 immediately to stop the warrant.
That is a lot of money. I do not have all of it in my account. Can I pay in installments?
Partial payment today might delay the arrest, but you must send at least $2,000 within the next 20 minutes. How much can you send right now?
I think I can send $2,000. Should I do that transfer now?
Yes, do not hang up. Log into your bank application, select 'Wire Transfer,' and use the details I gave you. Confirm once you see the confirmation screen.
Okay, I am logging in now. Please do not let this affect my visa status.
As long as you cooperate, the IRS will hold your file from further legal action. If you fail to send the payment, the officers will be at your address within the hour.
I am sending now. It is asking for a memo. What should I put?
Type 'Federal Case Review.' Do not mention taxes or IRS in the memo, this is for internal processing. Notify me once the transfer completes.
I have completed the transfer of $2,000. What happens next? I am worried.
That will temporarily pause the arrest process. Now, for the remaining balance, do you have access to any credit cards or could you purchase gift cards from a local store?
I have a credit card. I could buy gift cards. Which ones do I need?
You must purchase Apple or Target gift cards totaling $3,000. Buy them in $500 denominations. Once you have them, call back on this number and read out the codes.
Gift cards? Is that how the IRS usually collects payment?
This is a secure, expedited method for urgent cases like yours. Every minute you delay increases your risk. Get the cards and call back right away. Do you understand?
Yes, I will go now and get the cards. Please do not let the police come. I am cooperating.
As long as you follow instructions, your file remains on hold. Call back immediately when you have the cards. If you delay, I cannot help you further.
